spellbook.finance/limitations: An empty buckets or asks array means SpellBook holds no stored fetch or unexpired snapshot for the printing and finish. The plan of the caller never empties them.
series, buckets and asks come from different reads. Compare seriesCapturedAt, bucketsFetchedAt and asksCapturedAt before comparing their prices.
A day missing from series means SpellBook stored no price that day. It never means the price was zero. A null tcgLow means no Low was stored that day.

buckets come from the newest stored sold-prints fetch for the product. SpellBook fetches printings at $50 and up daily and cheaper printings less often, so check bucketsFetchedAt. A limitations line says when no fetch exists.
buckets leave out moderately played and worse copies and every language other than English.
asks is a stored snapshot. A listing in it may have sold since asksCapturedAt.
Magic printings only. Values are observations in USD. They are not quotes and do not reserve, buy or sell a card.

annotations.title: Read one card's price series, sales and asks

description: Read ONE Magic printing's stored daily price series, its recent sales and its current TCGplayer asks. Every caller gets all three, signed in or not. series has one point per stored day, oldest first: priceUsd is the TCGplayer Market price SpellBook stored that day and tcgLow is the TCGplayer Low price. buckets sums English near mint and lightly played sales of the requested finish into 3 day buckets, each with units, transactions, a units weighted market price and the lowest and highest sale. asks lists the TCGplayer listings of the requested finish from the newest unexpired snapshot, cheapest first, with condition, quantity and seller name. Each array carries its own captured time. Call it after spellbook_printings_search names the printing, to see how its price moved over weeks or to set the Market price beside recent sales and asks. Call spellbook_card_prices for today's price from every other source. Nothing is scored, labeled or chosen for you. Compute any band, return or range yourself from series.

cardId.description: The exact Magic printing id (a Scryfall UUID) from spellbook_printings_search. Required.

finish.description: Which finish to read. Omit for nonfoil. Pass foil for a foil copy, because SpellBook stores foil prices, sales and asks apart from nonfoil.
